info.description: A directed edge of the narrative graph: a choice offered in one scene that leads to another. When requires_mobility_check is true, the AI prediction forks it: next_scene on success, failure_scene on failure. hidden_modifiers (mobility checks only) changes the story's base profile before the AI evaluates it: integers are added to numeric traits, e.g. {"capital-gain": 5000, "age": 2}, and strings replace categorical traits, e.g. {"workclass": "Private"}. A delta of 0 changes nothing, so new decisions start from a zero template.

edit.label: Modificadores ocultos (solo pruebas de movilidad)
edit.description: Usa formato JSON válido. Para sumar o restar valores numéricos: {"capital-gain": 5000, "age": 2}. Para cambiar estados: {"workclass": "Private"}. Solo usa las variables permitidas del modelo: age, education-num, hours-per-week, capital-gain, capital-loss (números enteros) y workclass, education, marital-status, occupation, relationship, race, sex, native-country (texto). Los valores en 0 no cambian nada: cambia solo los números que la decisión debe alterar. Cualquier valor distinto de 0 requiere activar requires_mobility_check.
